summary: accepted_with_cautions after worker-2 Table 1/2 activity repair, worker-4 database conflict preservation, and worker-6 source-reviewed final adjudication from local materials.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review recovered all locally supported Table 1 and Table 2 activity/toxicity values, reconciled linked DBAASP rows where values match primary tables, preserved database-text and modification conflicts, and replaced automated mechanism placeholders with source-located bounded claims.

paper_xml.evidence: Article metadata, Table 1, Table 2, results sections, methods, and figure captions were parsed from paper.xml.

paper_pdf.evidence: pdftotext output crosschecked Table 1, Table 2, methods, and mechanism narrative.

oa_package.evidence: OA package was unpacked and local NXML/PDF/figure/supplement members were available in the packet.

supplementary_assets.evidence: Supplement PDF text was opened; it contains resistance profile, membrane interaction/TEM/DLS/AFM/crystallography/compound characterization, but no structured activity table beyond main-text Tables 1/2.

merged_database_rows.evidence: Linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP/literature rows and merged sequence catalog rows were checked against primary XML/PDF tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reconciled linked DBAASP assay/literature rows against primary Table 1/2 values; source_verified rows have primary table locators, compressed CAMP/dbAMP rows are source_conflict, and N-methylated X-placeholder rows are sequence_modified_not_normalized.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 rebuilt 112 source-supported activity/toxicity rows from primary XML/PDF Tables 1 and 2 with endpoint, raw value, unit, target, assay conditions, and locators. 8 n.d. cells were preserved as not_determined_entries, not fabricated rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced pending-review mechanism notes with source-located SYTOX, TEM, DLS/CF leakage, AFM, and X-ray structural support claims, each bounded by limitations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_closeout: The prior rework ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is closed because the owner-layer omissions are repaired and remaining issues are nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Linked DBAASP row DBAASPS_11913 reports human-erythrocyte concentration >2000 µg/mL, but primary Table 1 reports RH1 MHC 1000 µg/mL; primary value is retained and the database row remains source_conflict.
caution_findings.resolution: Preserved in database_record_verification.json as source_conflict rather than smoothing the value.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP linked records are sparse or compressed entry-text annotations and sometimes contain formatting artifacts; they are not used as primary assay rows.
caution_findings.resolution: Final activity values come from primary Tables 1/2 with source locators; CAMP/dbAMP rows remain source_conflict provenance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP sequence rows for RH18/RH19/RH20 use X placeholders for N-methylated residues while the primary table reports explicit N-methylated peptide-bond notation.
caution_findings.resolution: Rows are retained as sequence_modified_not_normalized with Table 1 modification locators.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figure and supplement images support mechanism direction, but full curves/images were not converted into extra numeric activity rows.
caution_findings.resolution: Mechanism claims are limited to source-stated qualitative/assay-level conclusions and no figure-only exact values are fabricated.
